title: ICAR IVRI Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Young Professional II Posts
description: Indian Veterinary Research Institute (ICAR IVRI) has released the official notification for Young Professional II Posts. Candidates who have qualified in Post Graduation, B.V.Sc, and M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the ICAR IVRI Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
